requirements.statement: Collector event-retention backlogs drain automatically in transactional batches of at most 500 events, one batch per lock hold and cycle, with identical final records and resumability.
Provider attestation status and project health have flat SQLite VM work with fixed provider evidence as unrelated history grows, preserving answers and owner verification.
Bound the full-scan admission evaluation in host opens using selective existing indexes, preserving preflight and write-time decisions.
